scripts.bootstrap: cdkd bootstrap --region ap-northeast-1 && cdkd bootstrap --region us-east-1
scripts.t3poc:bootstrap: A=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text) && cdkd bootstrap --region ap-northeast-1 --state-bucket t3poc-cdkd-state-$A --asset-bucket t3poc-cdkd-assets-$A-ap-northeast-1 --container-repo t3poc-cdkd-container-assets-$A-ap-northeast-1
scripts.t3poc:diff: export T3_POC_ONLY=1 AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-1 CDKD_STATE_BUCKET=t3poc-cdkd-state-$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text) && cdkd diff T3pocMicrovmStack --state-bucket $CDKD_STATE_BUCKET
scripts.t3poc:deploy: export T3_POC_ONLY=1 AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-1 CDKD_STATE_BUCKET=t3poc-cdkd-state-$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text) && cdkd deploy T3pocMicrovmStack --full-wait --state-bucket $CDKD_STATE_BUCKET
scripts.t3poc:destroy: export T3_POC_ONLY=1 AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-1 CDKD_STATE_BUCKET=t3poc-cdkd-state-$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text) && cdkd destroy T3pocMicrovmStack --state-bucket $CDKD_STATE_BUCKET
